title: peer-contract v0.1 - Multi-turn Sub-session Collaboration
description: Multi-turn collaboration: sub-session lifecycle, acceptance criteria (AC) chain, yield patterns. Solves core problem #3 (multi-turn collaboration) - complex tasks need multi-round sub-sessions, not single-shot subagent.

lifecycle.description: Current lifecycle state of this sub-session or collaboration.

yield_pattern.description: Expected state transitions. First element is initial state. Each subsequent element is a valid next state.

sub_session_request.description: If this is a spawn request (lifecycle=spawn_request), details for the new sub-session.

task_id.description: Task identifier. Used to group dispatches under one task and tie AC chain.

parent_session_key.description: Spawning session. Work session's parent must be the dispatcher. HR2 enforces.

expected_yield.description: Yield expectation. single_yield = one report back, done. multi_yield = periodic reports + final. incremental = each step is a yield. final_only = no reports until done.

tool_allowlist.description: Optional. If set, sub-session tool set is restricted to this list. Default = work session tool policy (see HR9).

yield_target.description: Where to send yields. Default = parent_session_key.

acceptance_criteria.description: AC for this task. Once accepted, certain fields are immutable (see HR7).

card_id.description: Unique AC identifier. Tied to task_id. Reference this in ac_chain.

criteria_text.description: Human-readable description of what acceptance means. Once accepted (status=accepted), this field is immutable for the worker (HR7).

accepted_by.description: Session key that accepted. Set on first transition to status=accepted. IMMUTABLE after first set (HR7).

status.description: AC status. Worker can transition: accepted → in_progress → completed/rejected. Cannot revert. Cannot extend ac_chain (HR7).

evidence_dispatch_ids.description: Optional. Dispatch IDs that constitute evidence of completion. Set when status=completed.

ac_chain.description: Acceptance chain - sequence of AC nodes. Each worker can only add to their own AC; cannot modify other workers' ACs (HR7).

owner_session_key.description: Session that owns this AC. Can only be modified by owner. Other sessions get read-only access.

immutable_after_accept.description: If true, this AC node is immutable once status=accepted. HR7 enforces.

acceptance_criteria.criteria_text: Plugin src has all 9 HR enforced and tests pass
